patterns.note: The homepage features a full-bleed hero section with a prominent, interactive currency converter form directly integrated into the main visual space.
A high-contrast palette is used, pairing a vibrant, almost neon green with a deep, dark green for text and accents, set against clean white and light grey backgrounds.
Headings utilize a large, bold sans-serif typeface for strong impact and clear hierarchy, complemented by a highly readable sans-serif for body text.
Content sections and key elements appear with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Sections are visually delineated by alternating background colors (vibrant green, white, and light grey), creating clear breaks and guiding the user's eye down the page.

technique_notes: The hero section integrates a functional, interactive form directly into the primary visual area, making the core offering immediately accessible and actionable.
Content sections and key elements are designed to animate into view with subtle fade-in or slide-up effects as the user scrolls down the page, likely utilizing CSS keyframes for smooth transitions.
Cards and interactive elements consistently feature rounded corners and subtle drop shadows, providing a soft, approachable aesthetic while maintaining visual depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) create strong visual anchors, paired with a clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and card elements, contributing to a soft and modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks, preventing a dense appearance.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, almost neon green as a primary brand color, combined with bold, direct typography and a highly functional, interactive hero section, immediately conveys a sense of modern efficiency and approachability in financial services. The direct integration of the currency converter into the hero is a standout feature.
